# opalstack_ip (Data Source)

Looks up an IP address of a server, for use as the `ip4_id` or `ip6_id` of a site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The primary IPv4 address of a server, for the ip4_id of a site.
data "opalstack_ip" "v4" {
  server_id = data.opalstack_server.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) UUID of the server the address belongs to.

### Optional

- `primary` (Boolean) Whether to look for the server's primary address. Defaults to `true`.
- `type` (String) Address family, `4` or `6`. Defaults to `4`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the address.
- `ip` (String) The address.
